default: false; the first expandable item starts open
effect: sets the initial outer-array panel and expandable-item disclosure state without changing array data; the outer panel collapses only when collapsible is enabled
precedence: local boolean overrides config.jsonformsExtended.array.collapsed, then shared config.jsonformsExtended.collapsed; legacy local initCollapsed applies only when no portable collapse default is supplied; flat config.collapsed is ignored

effect: allows the outer array panel to toggle without discarding row editors or changing array data; false keeps it visible even when collapsed is true
precedence: local boolean, including false, overrides config.jsonformsExtended.collapsible, then flat config.collapsible

effect: true leaves a newly inserted expandable item closed while preserving the open state of existing items and the committed array value
precedence: local boolean, including false, overrides flat config.collapseNewItems; the initial-item collapsed option is independent
